provenance.reference: Controlled black-box observation per Tests/SystemTests/Plans/M2-022-barrier-server-fixtures.md on the owner-approved Ubuntu 22.04 x86_64 host: external Barrier server barriers 2.4.0-release protocol 1.6 and external Barrier client barrierc 2.4.0-release protocol 1.6, each on its own virtual X display, through a byte-logging loopback relay. Input was synthetic (xdotool on the server display). TLS disabled for this observation only; product TLS default stays enabled. Server is the Linux Barrier server, not a macOS one; Windows not executed (M2 validation is Linux-only by owner decision, 2026-10-28). Session: handshake, enter, a synthetic clipboard change on the client display, leave, then the server process paused until the client gave up on keepalive. Client-to-server DCLP data is zero-filled at its original length.
